mentions.name: Peeekly
mentions.description: This web analytics tool presents site metrics in a simple UI and automatically generates suggestions for improving conversions, such as guiding users from one page to another or getting them to submit a form. The author reports using it on a site with over 100k monthly page views, where about 70% of its suggestions were valid and used to make improvements.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am building https://peeekly.com it's an analytics tool on steroids. It shows you everything in very simple terms/ui and also generate suggestions on how to improve the conversations.
